content:
Here's the Iliad in emoji form:

🏺🇬🇷 vs 🏺🇹🇷
👑🤴 (Agamemnon) 😡 with 💪🏹 (Achilles)
💁‍♀️ (Briseis) taken from 💪🏹
💪🏹 quits fighting 😤
🏺🇬🇷 start losing 😱
🤯 (Patroclus) wears 💪🏹 armor
🤯 gets 💀 by 🦸‍♂️ (Hector)
💪🏹 RAGE 🔥🔥🔥
💪🏹 kills 🦸‍♂️ (Hector)
🏺🇹🇷 sad 😭
💪🏹 drags 🦸‍♂️ body around walls
👴 (Priam) begs for 🦸‍♂️ body
💪🏹 gives back body
🏺 (Troy) will fall soon 🔥

Basically: Epic battle, hero rage, tragedy, revenge, more tragedy! 🗡️⚔️
